title: Book Three · Chapter 149: The Tickets They Buy
story:
On Friday, the last day of term, a cold wind follows Ronan and Anna from the school gate.

Winter has reached the city. Anna pulls her jacket closed and shows him the confirmation from the design school.

It arrived on Wednesday. There are two visitor names: Anna and her mother.

“Eleven tomorrow,” she says. “We need to be there by a quarter to eleven.”

The school has sent a small route drawing. It is twenty minutes on foot from the arrival station.

“You will have time after the bus,” Ronan says.

“If it runs on time. Mum wants an early start here.”

Her mother is waiting near the bread shop. They walk to the station together. Ronan goes with them as far as the ticket window.

Anna's mother asks about tomorrow's early bus. The woman checks the book.

“Seven. About three hours.”

“And the return?”

“Six in the evening. Still six yuan each way.”

Anna takes out twelve yuan of her saved money. Her mother puts another twelve beside it. They buy the two return tickets.

Ronan stands back while the woman writes the seats and times. He has no ticket in that little pile.

Outside, Anna checks the morning time against the school sheet. Her mother checks the return.

“We will bring lunch,” her mother says. “I have four extra yuan for food or small needs.”

Anna puts the tickets in her own bag. She keeps the confirmation with them, inside a small pocket. Her mother keeps the extra money in her purse.

Ronan looks at the darkening sky beyond the station roof.

“A long day.”

“We should be back about nine,” Anna says.

“You will want the bed.”

“After I tell Mum about every window again.”

Her mother smiles. “I will have seen the windows too.”

Anna laughs and folds the route drawing. Ronan can see her excitement now. It hurts a little to stand outside the plan, but he likes that look on her face.

At the road, he gives her hand a brief squeeze.

“Have a good visit.”

“I will tell you on Sunday.”

Her mother waits a few steps away while Anna says goodbye. Then the two go home to pack their lunch.

Ronan walks back past the market. At home, he puts his own work dates beside his school book. Tomorrow is the third morning. He folds his clean work cloth and leaves it beside his water bottle.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

on foot＝步行；return ticket＝往返票；purse＝零钱包；squeeze＝轻握、轻挤。

## 理解问题

1. 母女实际买了几个人的票、各由谁付多少？额外四元由谁保管？
2. 早班、车程、步行和参观报到时间是否能衔接？返回本城大约几点？

## 读句子

**They buy the two return tickets.**

拆开看：They / buy / the two return tickets.

她们／买下／那两张往返票。
